description: Values transcribed for the project page; protocols retain separate observation contracts.

protocols.label: Closed-loop
protocols.title: Acquire evidence that makes a shared skill executable
protocols.contract: Select views sequentially under an initial budget H = 5. Every method uses the same candidate set, scripted skills, and hidden postcondition evaluator.
protocols.sample: 500 frozen coffee cases; 3 inference repeats per case, giving 1,500 episodes per method at this setting.
protocols.takeaway: The ledger alone is insufficient. Scoring views by missing command-relevant evidence raises success from 12.4% for Target ledger to 97.9% for View Belief Map; optional repair brings the primary result to 98.8%.

protocols.label: Same-object OOD
protocols.title: Follow the command when object identity stays the same
protocols.contract: Keep object identity fixed while changing the required function. The primary initial observation budget is H = 3.
protocols.sample: 500 frozen coffee cases; 3 inference repeats per case, giving 1,500 episodes per method at this setting.
protocols.takeaway: Seeing a plausible object part does not establish that it is the right part for this command. The command-bound reference reaches 98.9%, while command-agnostic affordance selection reaches 19.7%.

protocols.label: VLM ranking
protocols.title: Can a VLM select useful evidence after seeing every candidate?
protocols.contract: Each model previews all 12 RGB candidates and returns exactly 3 unique ranked view IDs. This differs from the sequential acquisition protocol.
protocols.sample: 1,500 complete evaluator records per model. All seven models pass the archived output-format, candidate-membership, provenance, and no-fallback admission gate.
protocols.takeaway: Overall success ranges from 26.0% to 42.9%. Task-level results show that several models do well on visually salient Tamp or Place cases while struggling on Insert, Serve, or Grind.
